independent_audio_agreement_historical.note: Agreement between independent model sizes is a lower bound on shared speech content. It is NOT a WER substitute: two models can agree on the same error. Used only for audio that has no human-verified reference transcript.

acceptance.note: A Bengali human-speech WER and an independently verified evaluation split are mandatory to claim either direction acceptance.
